scope: parking (parking, stopping and standing a vehicle, and where each is not allowed)

vocabulary.definition: A person who drives or is in actual physical control of a vehicle (CVC 305).
To stop or stand a vehicle, occupied or not, other than briefly while actually loading or unloading merchandise or passengers (CVC 463).
To halt a vehicle, occupied or not, other than briefly while actually picking up or dropping off passengers (CVC 586).
Any halt in the movement of a vehicle, except when needed to avoid conflict with other traffic or to obey a PEACE OFFICER or an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE (CVC 587).
A way or place of any nature publicly maintained and open to the public for vehicle travel, including streets (CVC 360).
The portion of a HIGHWAY improved, designed or ordinarily used for vehicle travel (CVC 530).
A HIGHWAY in respect to which the owners of abutting lands have no right or easement of access (CVC 332).
The area within the lateral curb lines, or the lateral boundary lines of the ROADWAYS, of two HIGHWAYS that join one another at approximately right angles (CVC 365).

The portion of a ROADWAY at an INTERSECTION included within the prolongation of the sidewalk lines, whether marked or unmarked, or any portion of a ROADWAY marked for pedestrian crossing by lines or other markings (CVC 275).
A section of sidewalk or curb that extends into the ROADWAY at a CROSSWALK.
The portion of a HIGHWAY, other than the ROADWAY, set apart by curbs, barriers, markings or other delineation for pedestrian travel (CVC 555).
The area or space officially set apart within a ROADWAY for the exclusive use of pedestrians and protected or marked by signs or markings (CVC 540).
A portion of a HIGHWAY where at least half of the frontage on one side for 600 feet, or on both sides for 300 feet, is occupied by buildings used for business (CVC 235).
A portion of a HIGHWAY where at least 13 separate dwelling houses or business structures front on one side within 1/4 mile, or 16 on both sides within 1/4 mile (CVC 515).
A police officer or other law enforcement officer authorized to direct traffic.
A sign, signal, marking (including curb paint) or device placed by a public authority to regulate, warn or guide traffic (CVC 440).
A curb painted red, marking a zone where stopping, standing and parking are prohibited (CVC 21458).
A curb painted yellow, marking a zone where stopping is allowed only to load or unload passengers or freight for the posted time (CVC 21458).
A curb painted white, marking a zone where stopping is allowed only to load or unload passengers or to deposit mail in an adjacent mailbox (CVC 21458).
A curb painted green, marking a zone of time-limited parking (CVC 21458).
A curb painted blue, marking parking reserved exclusively for disabled persons and vehicles transporting them (CVC 21458).
A valid distinguishing placard or special license plate issued by the DMV to a disabled person or disabled veteran.
A parking stall or space marked or signed as reserved for vehicles displaying a DISABLED PLACARD, including a space at a BLUE CURB.
The area marked with crosshatched (diagonal) lines next to a DISABLED PARKING SPACE, used for wheelchair and lift access.
A curb, roadway edge or off-street parking area location designated as a fire lane by the fire department and marked by signs or red curb paint (CVC 22500.1).
A lane on a ROADWAY established and marked for the preferential use of bicycles (Class II bikeway).
A person riding a bicycle.
Left with no licensed DRIVER present in the vehicle who is able to move it.

rules.title: Obey no-stopping and no-parking signs
rules.when: an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE prohibits or restricts stopping, standing or parking at a place or time
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle contrary to that OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE
rules.unless: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER
rules.statement: WHEN an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE prohibits or restricts stopping, standing or parking at a place or time, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle contrary to that OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE, UNLESS necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER.
rules.note: Based on CVC 22505, 22506 and local ordinances; the handbook says never park where there is a 'No Parking' sign. Fines are set locally.

rules.title: Posted time limits
rules.when: a sign or curb marking limits the time a vehicle may be PARKED
rules.action: PARK the vehicle longer than the posted time
rules.unless: the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD
rules.statement: WHEN a sign or curb marking limits the time a vehicle may be PARKED, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle longer than the posted time, UNLESS the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD.
rules.note: Time limits are set by local ordinance. The DISABLED PLACARD exemption is in CVC 22511.5, and see PARK-DIS-05 for its limits.

rules.title: Park parallel within 18 inches of the right curb
rules.when: PARKING on a ROADWAY with an adjacent curb
rules.action: PARK with the right-hand wheels parallel to and within 18 inches of the right-hand curb
rules.unless: signs or markings permit angle parking OR local ordinance permits PARKING on the left side of a one-way ROADWAY
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING on a ROADWAY with an adjacent curb, the DRIVER MUST PARK with the right-hand wheels parallel to and within 18 inches of the right-hand curb, UNLESS signs or markings permit angle parking OR local ordinance permits PARKING on the left side of a one-way ROADWAY.
rules.note: CVC 22502. This also means a driver may not park facing against traffic on the wrong side of the street.

rules.title: Left-side parking on one-way streets
rules.when: PARKING on a one-way ROADWAY AND local ordinance permits left-side parking
rules.action: PARK with the left-hand wheels parallel to and within 18 inches of the left-hand curb
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING on a one-way ROADWAY AND local ordinance permits left-side parking, the DRIVER MAY PARK with the left-hand wheels parallel to and within 18 inches of the left-hand curb.

rules.title: Angle parking only where marked
rules.when: signs or pavement markings indicate angle parking
rules.action: PARK at an angle to the curb, within the marked space
rules.statement: WHEN signs or pavement markings indicate angle parking, the DRIVER MAY ONLY PARK at an angle to the curb, within the marked space.
rules.note: Angle parking is permitted by local ordinance as an exception to CVC 22502.

rules.title: Rural areas: park off the roadway
rules.when: outside a BUSINESS DISTRICT or RESIDENCE DISTRICT AND it is practicable to STOP, PARK or leave the vehicle off the ROADWAY
rules.action: STOP, PARK or leave the vehicle standing on the ROADWAY
rules.unless: the vehicle is so disabled that it is impossible to avoid stopping it on the ROADWAY
rules.statement: WHEN outside a BUSINESS DISTRICT or RESIDENCE DISTRICT AND it is practicable to STOP, PARK or leave the vehicle off the ROADWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, PARK or leave the vehicle standing on the ROADWAY, UNLESS the vehicle is so disabled that it is impossible to avoid stopping it on the ROADWAY.

vague_terms.explanation: no test of when off-roadway parking is practicable

rules.note: CVC 22504(a). Does not apply on HIGHWAYS where signs permit roadway parking.

rules.title: Rural areas: width and 200-foot view
rules.when: STOPPING, PARKING or leaving the vehicle standing on the ROADWAY outside a BUSINESS DISTRICT or RESIDENCE DISTRICT
rules.action: leave an unobstructed width of the ROADWAY opposite the vehicle for other vehicles to pass AND ensure a clear view of the vehicle from 200 feet in each direction
rules.unless: the vehicle is so disabled that it is impossible to comply
rules.statement: WHEN STOPPING, PARKING or leaving the vehicle standing on the ROADWAY outside a BUSINESS DISTRICT or RESIDENCE DISTRICT, the DRIVER MUST leave an unobstructed width of the ROADWAY opposite the vehicle for other vehicles to pass AND ensure a clear view of the vehicle from 200 feet in each direction, UNLESS the vehicle is so disabled that it is impossible to comply.

rules.title: No stopping on a freeway
rules.when: on a FREEWAY
rules.action: STOP, PARK or leave the vehicle standing
rules.unless: necessary to avoid injury or damage to persons or property OR the vehicle is disabled OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE OR stopping is specifically permitted by signs
rules.statement: WHEN on a FREEWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, PARK or leave the vehicle standing, UNLESS necessary to avoid injury or damage to persons or property OR the vehicle is disabled OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE OR stopping is specifically permitted by signs.
rules.note: CVC 21718. The handbook says never park on a freeway except in an emergency, when directed by an officer or device, or where a stop is specifically permitted.

rules.title: No abandoning a vehicle
rules.when: leaving a vehicle on a HIGHWAY or on public or private property
rules.action: abandon the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN leaving a vehicle on a HIGHWAY or on public or private property, the DRIVER MUST NOT abandon the vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: no time or test given in the rule itself

rules.note: CVC 22523. A fine applies, but the amount is not stated here.

rules.title: 72-hour limit
rules.when: a local ordinance limits on-street parking to 72 hours
rules.action: leave the vehicle PARKED on a HIGHWAY in the same location for 72 or more consecutive hours
rules.statement: WHEN a local ordinance limits on-street parking to 72 hours, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave the vehicle PARKED on a HIGHWAY in the same location for 72 or more consecutive hours.
rules.note: The 72-hour limit comes from local ordinances, which CVC 22651(k) enables. It does not apply everywhere.

rules.title: Not in an intersection
rules.when: within an INTERSECTION
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE OR adjacent to a curb where local ordinance permits
rules.statement: WHEN within an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE OR adjacent to a curb where local ordinance permits.

rules.title: Not on a crosswalk
rules.when: on a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN on a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE.
rules.note: CVC 22500(b). Where local ordinance authorizes it, a common-carrier bus or taxicab may stop in an unmarked crosswalk to load or unload passengers.

rules.title: Daylighting: 20 feet before a crosswalk
rules.when: within 20 feet of the vehicle approach side of a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK OR within 15 feet of a CROSSWALK where a CURB EXTENSION is present
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: a local authority has marked or signed a different distance OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER
rules.statement: WHEN within 20 feet of the vehicle approach side of a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK OR within 15 feet of a CROSSWALK where a CURB EXTENSION is present, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS a local authority has marked or signed a different distance OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER.
rules.note: CVC 22500(n), added by AB 413 and in effect from 1 January 2024; only warnings were issued during 2024. The exact scope of the local-authority exception is uncertain.

rules.title: Not beside a safety zone
rules.when: between a SAFETY ZONE and the adjacent right-hand curb OR within the area between the SAFETY ZONE and the curb indicated by signs or markings
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN between a SAFETY ZONE and the adjacent right-hand curb OR within the area between the SAFETY ZONE and the curb indicated by signs or markings, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: Fire station driveway
rules.when: within 15 feet of the driveway entrance to a fire station OR on the opposite side of the street within 75 feet of that entrance where signs are posted
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: the vehicle is a clearly marked fire department vehicle OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER
rules.statement: WHEN within 15 feet of the driveway entrance to a fire station OR on the opposite side of the street within 75 feet of that entrance where signs are posted, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS the vehicle is a clearly marked fire department vehicle OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER.
rules.note: CVC 22500(d). The 75-foot opposite-side rule applies only when signs are posted; confirm the exact wording.

rules.title: Not in front of a driveway
rules.when: in front of a public or private driveway
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE OR local ordinance permits it
rules.statement: WHEN in front of a public or private driveway, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE OR local ordinance permits it.
rules.note: CVC 22500(e). Where authorized locally, buses, school buses and taxicabs may stop to load or unload. Local ordinance may also let a residential owner or lessee park in front of their own driveway.

rules.title: Not on a sidewalk
rules.when: on any portion of a SIDEWALK OR where the body of the vehicle would extend over any portion of a SIDEWALK
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN on any portion of a SIDEWALK OR where the body of the vehicle would extend over any portion of a SIDEWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE.
rules.note: CVC 22500(f). The handbook says not to park on, or partially block, a sidewalk.

rules.title: Not beside an excavation or obstruction
rules.when: alongside or opposite a street or HIGHWAY excavation or obstruction AND stopping would obstruct traffic
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN alongside or opposite a street or HIGHWAY excavation or obstruction AND stopping would obstruct traffic, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: No double parking
rules.when: on the ROADWAY side of a vehicle that is stopped, PARKED or standing at the curb or edge of the HIGHWAY
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: the vehicle is a schoolbus loading or unloading pupils OR local ordinance permits it for loading or unloading OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER
rules.statement: WHEN on the ROADWAY side of a vehicle that is stopped, PARKED or standing at the curb or edge of the HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS the vehicle is a schoolbus loading or unloading pupils OR local ordinance permits it for loading or unloading OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER.

rules.title: Not at a bus loading curb
rules.when: alongside curb space set aside for loading or unloading passengers of a common-carrier bus AND the space is indicated by a sign or red curb paint
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: the vehicle is such a bus OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER
rules.statement: WHEN alongside curb space set aside for loading or unloading passengers of a common-carrier bus AND the space is indicated by a sign or red curb paint, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS the vehicle is such a bus OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER.

rules.title: Not in a tunnel
rules.when: in a tube or tunnel
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: the vehicle belongs to the authority in charge of the tunnel OR signs permit it OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER
rules.statement: WHEN in a tube or tunnel, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS the vehicle belongs to the authority in charge of the tunnel OR signs permit it OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER.
rules.note: CVC 22500(j). The handbook says not in a tunnel or on a bridge except where signs permit.

rules.title: Not on a bridge
rules.when: on a bridge
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: signs permit it OR the vehicle belongs to the authority in charge of the bridge OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER
rules.statement: WHEN on a bridge, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS signs permit it OR the vehicle belongs to the authority in charge of the bridge OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER.

rules.title: Wheelchair curb cut
rules.when: in front of or upon a portion of curb that has been cut down, lowered or built to give wheelchair access to the SIDEWALK
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN in front of or upon a portion of curb that has been cut down, lowered or built to give wheelchair access to the SIDEWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE.

rules.title: Three feet from a sidewalk ramp
rules.when: within 3 feet of a SIDEWALK ramp for disabled persons
rules.action: PARK the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 3 feet of a SIDEWALK ramp for disabled persons, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle.
rules.note: From the California Driver Handbook's list of places never to park. The 3-foot figure is from the handbook, not from CVC 22500(l).

rules.title: Fire hydrant: 15 feet
rules.when: within 15 feet of a fire hydrant
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: a licensed DRIVER is seated in the front seat and can immediately move the vehicle OR the vehicle is a clearly marked fire department vehicle OR a local ordinance sets a different distance shown by signs or markings
rules.statement: WHEN within 15 feet of a fire hydrant, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS a licensed DRIVER is seated in the front seat and can immediately move the vehicle OR the vehicle is a clearly marked fire department vehicle OR a local ordinance sets a different distance shown by signs or markings.
rules.note: CVC 22514. Fines are set locally.

rules.title: Railroad tracks: 7½ feet
rules.when: on a railroad or rail transit track OR within 7½ feet of the nearest rail
rules.action: PARK the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on a railroad or rail transit track OR within 7½ feet of the nearest rail, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle.

rules.title: Fire lanes
rules.when: at a curb, ROADWAY edge or off-street parking location designated as a FIRE LANE by signs or red curb paint
rules.action: STOP, PARK or leave the vehicle standing
rules.unless: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE
rules.statement: WHEN at a curb, ROADWAY edge or off-street parking location designated as a FIRE LANE by signs or red curb paint, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, PARK or leave the vehicle standing, UNLESS necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER OR an OFFICIAL TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE.
rules.note: CVC 22500.1. Applies in private as well as public parking facilities.

rules.title: Red curb
rules.when: at a RED CURB
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle
rules.unless: the vehicle is a bus stopping at a RED CURB marked as a bus zone OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER
rules.statement: WHEN at a RED CURB, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle, UNLESS the vehicle is a bus stopping at a RED CURB marked as a bus zone OR necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic OR in compliance with the directions of a PEACE OFFICER.
rules.note: CVC 21458(a)(1). The handbook says buses may stop at a red zone marked for buses.

rules.title: Yellow curb: loading only
rules.when: at a YELLOW CURB
rules.action: STOP the vehicle for any purpose other than loading or unloading passengers or freight, or for longer than the posted time
rules.statement: WHEN at a YELLOW CURB, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP the vehicle for any purpose other than loading or unloading passengers or freight, or for longer than the posted time.
rules.note: CVC 21458(a)(2). Local ordinance may limit yellow zones to commercial vehicles and to certain hours.

rules.title: Yellow curb: noncommercial drivers stay with vehicle
rules.when: STOPPED at a YELLOW CURB AND local rules require drivers to stay with their vehicles
rules.action: stay with the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN STOPPED at a YELLOW CURB AND local rules require drivers to stay with their vehicles, the DRIVER of a noncommercial vehicle MUST stay with the vehicle.
rules.note: The handbook says noncommercial drivers are 'usually required' to stay with their vehicle at a yellow curb. The requirement depends on local rules.

rules.title: White curb: passengers or mail only
rules.when: at a WHITE CURB
rules.action: STOP the vehicle longer than needed to pick up or drop off passengers or to deposit mail in an adjacent mailbox
rules.statement: WHEN at a WHITE CURB, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP the vehicle longer than needed to pick up or drop off passengers or to deposit mail in an adjacent mailbox.
rules.note: CVC 21458(a)(3) and the handbook.

rules.title: Green curb: time limit
rules.when: PARKED at a GREEN CURB
rules.action: PARK longer than the time limit shown on the posted sign or painted on the curb
rules.unless: the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD
rules.statement: WHEN PARKED at a GREEN CURB, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK longer than the time limit shown on the posted sign or painted on the curb, UNLESS the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD.
rules.note: CVC 21458(a)(4) and 22511.5. The handbook says to look for the posted sign or the time painted on the curb.

rules.title: Blue curb: disabled only
rules.when: the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD AND is driven by or transporting the disabled person
rules.action: PARK at a BLUE CURB
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD AND is driven by or transporting the disabled person, the DRIVER MAY ONLY PARK at a BLUE CURB.
rules.note: CVC 21458(a)(5), 22507.8 and 42001.13. Placard misuse is also punishable under CVC 4461.

rules.title: Disabled parking spaces
rules.when: at a DISABLED PARKING SPACE
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle standing in that space
rules.unless: the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD AND is being used by or to transport the disabled person
rules.statement: WHEN at a DISABLED PARKING SPACE, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle standing in that space, UNLESS the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD AND is being used by or to transport the disabled person.
rules.penalty: Fine of $250 to $1,000; the vehicle may be towed.

rules.title: Crosshatched access aisle
rules.when: at an ACCESS AISLE next to a DISABLED PARKING SPACE
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle standing in the ACCESS AISLE
rules.statement: WHEN at an ACCESS AISLE next to a DISABLED PARKING SPACE, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle standing in the ACCESS AISLE.
rules.note: CVC 22507.8(c). Applies even to vehicles displaying a DISABLED PLACARD.

rules.title: Do not block disabled parking access
rules.when: near a DISABLED PARKING SPACE or ACCESS AISLE
rules.action: PARK the vehicle so that it obstructs, blocks or otherwise bars access to the space or ACCESS AISLE
rules.statement: WHEN near a DISABLED PARKING SPACE or ACCESS AISLE, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle so that it obstructs, blocks or otherwise bars access to the space or ACCESS AISLE.

rules.title: Placard: time limits and meters
rules.when: the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD AND is being used by or to transport the disabled person
rules.action: PARK without time limit in a time-limited zone or at a GREEN CURB, and at a parking meter without payment
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD AND is being used by or to transport the disabled person, the DRIVER MAY PARK without time limit in a time-limited zone or at a GREEN CURB, and at a parking meter without payment.
rules.note: CVC 22511.5(a). Some private or gated facilities and local exceptions may differ.

rules.title: Placard does not override prohibitions
rules.when: the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD AND stopping, standing or parking is prohibited to all vehicles OR the space is reserved for special types of vehicles OR parking is prohibited at that time for street cleaning or towing
rules.action: PARK the vehicle there
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle displays a DISABLED PLACARD AND stopping, standing or parking is prohibited to all vehicles OR the space is reserved for special types of vehicles OR parking is prohibited at that time for street cleaning or towing, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle there.
rules.note: CVC 22511.5(b), as recalled; check the exact list of exclusions.

rules.title: EV charging spaces
rules.when: at a parking space designated and signed for electric vehicle charging
rules.action: STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle in that space
rules.unless: the vehicle is connected for electric charging
rules.statement: WHEN at a parking space designated and signed for electric vehicle charging, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, STAND or PARK the vehicle in that space, UNLESS the vehicle is connected for electric charging.
rules.penalty: The vehicle may be towed when signs are posted.
rules.note: CVC 22511.1. The handbook also lists zero-emission vehicle spaces as places not to park in unless eligible.

rules.title: Downhill with curb
rules.when: PARKING headed downhill next to a curb
rules.action: turn the front wheels into the curb and set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING headed downhill next to a curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels into the curb and set the parking brake.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: Uphill with curb
rules.when: PARKING headed uphill next to a curb
rules.action: turn the front wheels away from the curb, let the vehicle roll back slightly until the rear of a front wheel rests against the curb, and set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING headed uphill next to a curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels away from the curb, let the vehicle roll back slightly until the rear of a front wheel rests against the curb, and set the parking brake.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: Hill with no curb
rules.when: PARKING on a hill where there is no curb, uphill or downhill
rules.action: turn the front wheels so the vehicle will roll away from the center of the road if the brakes fail, and set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING on a hill where there is no curb, uphill or downhill, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels so the vehicle will roll away from the center of the road if the brakes fail, and set the parking brake.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook. In the US this means turning the wheels toward the right shoulder.

rules.title: Sloping driveway
rules.when: PARKING on a sloping driveway
rules.action: turn the wheels so the vehicle will not roll into the street if the brakes fail
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING on a sloping driveway, the DRIVER MUST turn the wheels so the vehicle will not roll into the street if the brakes fail.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook.

rules.title: Block wheels on a grade
rules.when: leaving the vehicle PARKED or standing UNATTENDED on a grade on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: block the wheels by turning them against the curb or by other means
rules.statement: WHEN leaving the vehicle PARKED or standing UNATTENDED on a grade on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST block the wheels by turning them against the curb or by other means.

rules.title: Unattended: engine off, brakes set
rules.when: leaving a motor vehicle standing UNATTENDED on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: first effectively set the brakes and stop the engine
rules.statement: WHEN leaving a motor vehicle standing UNATTENDED on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST first effectively set the brakes and stop the engine.

rules.title: Parking brake and gear
rules.when: PARKING the vehicle
rules.action: set the parking brake and leave the vehicle in park, or in gear for a manual transmission
rules.statement: WHEN PARKING the vehicle, the DRIVER MUST set the parking brake and leave the vehicle in park, or in gear for a manual transmission.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook ('always').

rules.title: Child left in vehicle
rules.when: a child 6 years old or younger is in the vehicle AND conditions present a significant risk to the child's health or safety OR the engine is running OR the keys are in the ignition
rules.action: leave the child inside the vehicle
rules.unless: the child is supervised by a person at least 12 years old
rules.statement: WHEN a child 6 years old or younger is in the vehicle AND conditions present a significant risk to the child's health or safety OR the engine is running OR the keys are in the ignition, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave the child inside the vehicle, UNLESS the child is supervised by a person at least 12 years old.
rules.note: CVC 15620. Applies to the parent, guardian or other person responsible for the child.

rules.title: Animal left in vehicle
rules.when: an animal is in the vehicle AND heat, cold, lack of ventilation, lack of food or water or other conditions would endanger the animal's health or well-being
rules.action: leave or confine the animal in the UNATTENDED vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN an animal is in the vehicle AND heat, cold, lack of ventilation, lack of food or water or other conditions would endanger the animal's health or well-being, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave or confine the animal in the UNATTENDED vehicle.
rules.note: California Penal Code 597.7, not the Vehicle Code. Penalties vary.

rules.title: Do not lock a person inside
rules.when: leaving a PARKED vehicle
rules.action: lock a person inside the vehicle in a way that prevents them from escaping without a key, combination or other special knowledge
rules.statement: WHEN leaving a PARKED vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT lock a person inside the vehicle in a way that prevents them from escaping without a key, combination or other special knowledge.

rules.title: Opening doors on the traffic side
rules.when: the vehicle is STOPPED or PARKED
rules.action: open a door on the side open to moving traffic
rules.unless: it is reasonably safe to do so AND it can be done without interfering with the movement of traffic
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is STOPPED or PARKED, the DRIVER MUST NOT open a door on the side open to moving traffic, UNLESS it is reasonably safe to do so AND it can be done without interfering with the movement of traffic.
rules.note: CVC 22517. Applies to passengers as well.

rules.title: Do not leave a traffic-side door open
rules.when: a door on the side of the vehicle next to moving traffic is open
rules.action: leave the door open longer than necessary to load or unload passengers
rules.statement: WHEN a door on the side of the vehicle next to moving traffic is open, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave the door open longer than necessary to load or unload passengers.

rules.title: Look for cyclists before opening a door
rules.when: about to open a door of a PARKED vehicle
rules.action: check for approaching CYCLISTS and other traffic
rules.statement: WHEN about to open a door of a PARKED vehicle, the DRIVER MUST check for approaching CYCLISTS and other traffic.
rules.note: Based on the handbook's guidance on sharing the road with bicyclists; the exact wording and force are uncertain.

rules.title: Parallel parking: space length
rules.when: choosing a space to parallel PARK
rules.action: find a space at least 3 feet longer than the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN choosing a space to parallel PARK, the DRIVER SHOULD find a space at least 3 feet longer than the vehicle.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook parallel parking steps; the 3-foot figure is recalled from the handbook.

rules.title: Parallel parking: signal and check
rules.when: preparing to parallel PARK
rules.action: turn on the turn signal and check mirrors and over the shoulder for traffic before backing into the space
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to parallel PARK, the DRIVER MUST turn on the turn signal and check mirrors and over the shoulder for traffic before backing into the space.
rules.note: California Driver Handbook parallel parking steps. The handbook also describes pulling alongside the vehicle ahead with about 2 feet between vehicles.

rules.title: Entering a bike lane to park
rules.when: parking is permitted next to a BIKE LANE AND the DRIVER is entering or leaving that parking
rules.action: drive in the BIKE LANE
rules.statement: WHEN parking is permitted next to a BIKE LANE AND the DRIVER is entering or leaving that parking, the DRIVER MAY ONLY drive in the BIKE LANE.
rules.note: CVC 21209(a). Driving in a bike lane is also allowed to enter or leave the ROADWAY, and to prepare for a turn within 200 feet of an INTERSECTION. Drivers must yield to CYCLISTS in the lane.

rules.title: Starting from a parked position
rules.when: the vehicle is stopped, standing or PARKED on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: start the vehicle moving
rules.unless: the movement can be made with reasonable safety
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is stopped, standing or PARKED on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT start the vehicle moving, UNLESS the movement can be made with reasonable safety.

rules.title: Signal when pulling from the curb
rules.when: pulling away from the curb into traffic
rules.action: give the appropriate turn signal
rules.statement: WHEN pulling away from the curb into traffic, the DRIVER MUST give the appropriate turn signal.
rules.note: CVC 22107 (signal when moving left or right on the roadway); the handbook says to signal when pulling away from the curb.
